NpcBindings.Note: Bram's three states. Most progressed first: testing story.starter_chosen before story.pokedex would leave him refusing to open a gate he has already opened.

No default on purpose. Until the battle is done Kes is driven by the episodes -- opening_departure is triggered off him -- and a townsperson line offered at the same time would be a second way to talk to him that says something the scene has not reached yet.

Sequences.Note: Over black. Diamond/Pearl's title-screen professor monologue: name yourself, state the world, state the problem, ask who the player is. Auto-advancing until the two questions. Line 0 is the self-introduction the Korean DP script opens on -- without it a stranger lectures the player about 400 years of records.
Sequences.lineCountWarning: 8 lines. The choice on line 6 jumps to 7; inserting anything above it moves that target.

Lines.Text: My name is Linden. I study Pokémon, here in this valley.
Lines.TextKo: 내 이름은 린든. 이 골짜기에서 포켓몬을 연구하고 있네.

Lines.Text: People have kept records of this valley for four hundred years. Rainfall. Harvests. The depth of the lake in spring.
Lines.TextKo: 이 골짜기는 400년 동안 기록돼 왔네. 비가 언제 왔는지. 무엇을 얼마나 거뒀는지. 봄에 호수가 얼마나 깊었는지.

Lines.Text: And in the margin of every one of them, in a different hand, somebody has drawn a creature.
Lines.TextKo: 그 기록마다 여백에 그림이 있네. 손글씨는 다 다른데, 그린 건 늘 같은 것일세.

Lines.Text: Pokémon. We have lived beside them the entire time and written them down last.
Lines.TextKo: 포켓몬일세. 400년을 같이 살았는데 기록은 제일 늦었지.

Lines.Text: I intend to correct the order of that list. But I am seventy-one, and the valley is large.
Lines.TextKo: 그 순서를 바로잡을 생각이네. 그런데 나는 71일세. 골짜기는 넓고.

Lines.Text: So I have been waiting for somebody to come and stand in front of me. It appears to be you.
Lines.TextKo: 그래서 누가 오기를 기다렸네. 자네가 왔군.

Lines.Text: Before anything else. How do you see yourself?
Lines.TextKo: 시작하기 전에 하나 묻겠네. 자네는 남자인가? 아니면 여자인가?

Lines.Text: Good. Then tell me your name.
Lines.TextKo: 자네의 이름은?

Sequences.Note: Two lines, still over black. The second one is the cue for the fade.

Lines.Text: {PLAYER}. Yes. That will do.
Lines.TextKo: 흠… {PLAYER}라고 하는가. 좋은 이름이군!

Lines.Text: Open your eyes, then. It is already morning, and the valley does not record itself.
Lines.TextKo: 자, 눈을 뜨게. 아침일세. 기록은 저절로 남지 않네.

Sequences.Note: Diamond/Pearl's television report, moved to the plaza research terminal because this game has no house interiors. Its job is identical: name the anomaly, point at the lake, and be the only thing in the scene that has told the player anything. Korean is 합쇼체 -- this is the one speaker in the book that is addressing a town rather than a person.

Lines.Text: — and repeating the notice. The lake rose eleven centimetres overnight. There was no rain.
Lines.TextKo: …다시 알려 드립니다. 간밤에 호수 수위가 11센티미터 올랐습니다. 비는 오지 않았습니다.

Lines.Text: Residents are asked to keep clear of the basin until the survey team has been down.
Lines.TextKo: 조사팀이 내려갈 때까지 호수 쪽으로 가지 마십시오.

Lines.Text: That is all. Have a pleasant morning.
Lines.TextKo: 이상입니다. 좋은 아침 보내십시오.

Sequences.Note: Kes is Barry's function: he supplies the momentum the player has not earned yet. The choice on line 2 is cosmetic -- both answers land on line 3 -- because DP does not let you decline and offering a refusal you cannot take is worse than not asking.

Lines.Text: Eleven centimetres. With no rain. You heard it too — tell me you heard it.
Lines.TextKo: 11센티미터. 비도 안 왔대. 너도 들었지? 들었다고 해.

Lines.Text: The entire street heard that and went back to their bread.
Lines.TextKo: 동네 사람들 다 듣고도 그냥 밥 먹더라.

Lines.Text: I'm going down to the lake. Now, before the survey crew gets there and puts rope round it.
Lines.TextKo: 나 호수 간다. 지금. 조사팀이 줄 치기 전에.

Lines.Text: Then keep up. If I'm at the ramp and you aren't, I'm counting out loud.
Lines.TextKo: 따라와. 나보다 늦으면 소리 내서 셀 거야.

Sequences.Note: DP's mother warning you out of the tall grass, given to the NPC the layout already stood at the gate. Bram states the rule the whole first act is built on, in one sentence, before the player has any reason to resent it.

Lines.Text: Stop. Both of you. Stop.
Lines.TextKo: 멈춰요. 둘 다.

Lines.Text: That ramp goes down into grass that comes up past your chest, and there is something living in every metre of it.
Lines.TextKo: 저 비탈 아래는 가슴까지 오는 풀숲이에요. 발 디딜 데마다 뭐가 삽니다.

Lines.Text: I don't stand here for the view. Nobody goes down without a Pokémon. The rule is short so that people remember it.
Lines.TextKo: 내가 경치 보러 서 있는 게 아니에요. 포켓몬 없으면 못 내려갑니다. 규칙은 짧아야 다들 기억하죠.

Lines.Text: The lake is right there —
Lines.TextKo: 호수 바로 저긴데…

Lines.Text: It has been right there your whole life.
Lines.TextKo: 태어났을 때부터 거기 있었어요.

Sequences.Note: DP's two wild Starly, restaged as a scare instead of a battle. In DP the birds are the reason the briefcase gets opened; keeping that logic and dropping the fight means this opening has exactly one battle in it, and it is the one that matters. Line 0 is unattributed narration -- DialogueView drops the name plate and rule when SpeakerName is empty, which is what makes it read as the world rather than as a person.

Lines.Text: Something came up out of the grass below the ramp. A dozen of them, brown, shrieking, straight over the gate and gone north.
Lines.TextKo: 비탈 아래 풀숲에서 뭔가 확 솟았다. 갈색으로 열댓 마리, 비명을 지르며 관문을 넘어 북쪽으로 사라졌다.

Lines.Text: ...okay. That's new.
Lines.TextKo: …뭐야. 처음 본다.

Lines.Text: That is not new. That is Pidgey. They go up like that when something bigger walks under them.
Lines.TextKo: 처음 아니에요. 구구예요. 밑으로 큰 게 지나가면 저렇게 튀죠.

Lines.Text: So what's walking under them?
Lines.TextKo: 그럼 밑에 뭐가 지나갔는데?

Lines.Text: Ask me again when I know.
Lines.TextKo: 알게 되면 말해 줄게요.

Sequences.Note: DP's Rowan arriving to call the rival reckless, and then handing over the case anyway. Line 7 carries story.case_open for the VFX and sting.

Lines.Text: Bram. Let them past.
Lines.TextKo: 브람. 보내 주게.

Lines.Text: Professor —
Lines.TextKo: 박사님…

Lines.Text: I heard the birds from the lane. I have waited a long time for that lake to do something, and it has picked this morning.
Lines.TextKo: 골목에서도 새소리가 들리더군. 저 호수가 뭐라도 하기를 오래 기다렸네. 하필 오늘이군.

Lines.Text: Kes. You were going down there with nothing.
Lines.TextKo: 케스. 자네, 빈손으로 내려가려 했나.

Lines.Text: I was going down there fast.
Lines.TextKo: 빨리 가려던 거예요.

Lines.Text: Yes. That is the part that worries me.
Lines.TextKo: 그렇지. 그게 걱정일세.

Lines.Text: I was carrying these down to the basin myself. I am not carrying them and keeping up with you. So.
Lines.TextKo: 이걸 내가 들고 내려갈 참이었네. 자네들을 따라가면서 들 수는 없지. 그러니.

Lines.Text: Three. Born at the lab, healthy, and not one of them has ever been outside that building.
Lines.TextKo: 세 마리일세. 연구소에서 났고, 건강하고, 아직 밖에 나가 본 적이 없네.

Lines.Text: Take one. Then you may both go down that ramp, with my blessing and with Bram's.
Lines.TextKo: 하나 고르게. 그러면 내려가도 좋네. 브람도 더는 안 막을 걸세.

Sequences.Note: One line, then the balls. Short on purpose -- at this moment the player should be reading labels, not dialogue.

Lines.Text: Take your time over it. It is a long walk with the wrong one.
Lines.TextKo: 천천히 고르게. 오래 같이 갈 녀석일세.

Sequences.Note: Player took Bulbasaur (game id 1). Kes takes Charmander (game id 5).

Lines.Text: Bulbasaur. Grass and poison, with a garden strapped to its back. It does not win quickly. It declines to be finished.
Lines.TextKo: 이상해씨. 풀과 독일세. 등에 정원을 지고 다니지. 빨리 이기진 못해도 좀처럼 안 쓰러지네.

Lines.Text: Then I'm taking the one that sets gardens on fire. Charmander. Sorry. Not really sorry.
Lines.TextKo: 그럼 난 정원 태우는 쪽. 파이리. 미안. 별로 안 미안하고.

Sequences.Note: Player took Charmander (game id 5). Kes takes Squirtle (game id 10).

Lines.Text: Charmander. Fire, and not a great deal else yet. Keep that tail out of the rain and in six months you will not recognise it.
Lines.TextKo: 파이리. 불꽃일세. 지금은 그게 전부지. 꼬리만 젖지 않게 하게. 반년이면 몰라보게 클 걸세.

Lines.Text: Water puts out fire. Squirtle, please. That isn't me being clever, that's just how it works.
Lines.TextKo: 불은 물로 끄지. 난 꼬부기. 머리 쓴 거 아니야. 원래 그런 거지.

Sequences.Note: Player took Squirtle (game id 10). Kes takes Bulbasaur (game id 1).

Lines.Text: Squirtle. Water, and a roof it can climb inside when the day goes badly — which is more than most of us manage.
Lines.TextKo: 꼬부기. 물일세. 힘든 날엔 들어갈 지붕도 있지. 우리한텐 그것도 없네.

Lines.Text: And a plant drinks water. Bulbasaur, then. See? I do read.
Lines.TextKo: 식물은 물 먹고 크지. 그럼 난 이상해씨. 봐, 나도 책 본다니까.

Sequences.Note: The loan, not the gift. This is Diamond/Pearl exactly: at the lake the starter is only borrowed, and it becomes formally yours when Rowan registers it at the Sandgem lab. Keeping that distinction is what gives 'leaving_town' something to be about.

Lines.Text: It is yours to carry. Not yours to keep — not yet.
Lines.TextKo: 데리고 다니게. 아직 자네 것은 아니고.

Lines.Text: Come up to the lab when you have had your look at the lake and I will put it in the register in ink. Then it is a gift.
Lines.TextKo: 호수 보고 연구소로 오게. 기록에 잉크로 올려 주겠네. 그때부터 자네 걸세.

Lines.Text: Bram. The ramp.
Lines.TextKo: 브람. 비탈 열어 주게.

Lines.Text: The ramp is open.
Lines.TextKo: 열었어요.

Lines.Text: Mind the second step. It stays wet all morning.
Lines.TextKo: 두 번째 계단 조심해요. 아침엔 계속 젖어 있어요.

Sequences.Note: TrainerDefinition.PreBattle for trainer_rival_01. Played by TrainerController after the exclamation and the approach walk, so it starts mid-motion and does not need to re-establish anything.

Lines.Text: Wait. Wait, wait, wait.
Lines.TextKo: 잠깐. 잠깐잠깐잠깐.

Lines.Text: We are not walking down there with two brand-new Pokémon and no idea which of us is better at this.
Lines.TextKo: 갓 받은 포켓몬 들고, 누가 센지도 모르고 내려가냐.

Lines.Text: One battle. Here, at the gate, where Bram can watch it and tell the whole street.
Lines.TextKo: 한 판만. 여기서. 브람이 보고 온 동네에 떠들게.

Lines.Text: I will not be telling anybody.
Lines.TextKo: 난 아무한테도 말 안 해요.

Lines.Text: He'll tell everybody. Go!
Lines.TextKo: 다 떠벌릴걸. 간다!

Sequences.Note: TrainerDefinition.OnDefeat -- the player won.

Lines.Text: ...huh.
No — that's fine. That's information. Now I know.
Lines.TextKo: 아니, 됐어. 이것도 알아낸 거니까.

Lines.Text: Next time I'm not going first.
Lines.TextKo: 다음엔 내가 먼저 안 나가.

Sequences.Note: TrainerDefinition.OnPlayerDefeat -- the player lost. The rival battle is uphill by design (Kes always holds the type advantage), so this branch is likely and must not feel like a failure state. He points at the healing machine on the plaza, which is 3m from the spawn.

Lines.Text: HA! Ha!
Lines.TextKo: 하! 하!

Lines.Text: Don't look like that. It was four moves. Four moves is barely a battle.
Lines.TextKo: 그런 표정 짓지 마. 네 판 만에 끝났잖아. 그건 배틀도 아니지.

Lines.Text: Go and use the machine on the plaza. I'll wait. I'll even wait quietly.
Lines.TextKo: 광장 가서 회복하고 와. 기다릴게. 조용히 있을게.

Sequences.Note: TrainerDefinition.AfterDefeat -- talking to him again once the fight is over.

Lines.Text: Lake. As soon as you're ready. I'm not going down there on my own, obviously.
Lines.TextKo: 호수. 준비되면 바로 가자. 나 혼자는 안 내려가.

Sequences.Note: Played by the episode after the battle resolves, on BOTH branches. Written so it does not know or care who won -- Linden is commenting on the fact of the battle, not the result, which is what lets one sequence serve both outcomes without a branch the runner would have to carry.

Lines.Text: There. That is the thing I cannot teach and would not want to.
Lines.TextKo: 저걸세. 가르쳐서 되는 게 아니지. 가르치고 싶지도 않고.

Lines.Text: Two of them, five minutes old, and they already know what they are for.
Lines.TextKo: 받은 지 5분 된 것들이 벌써 제 할 일을 아네.

Lines.Text: Go on. And come up to the lab afterwards — I meant what I said about the ink.
Lines.TextKo: 가 보게. 끝나면 연구소로 오고. 잉크 얘기는 진심일세.

Sequences.Note: Diamond/Pearl's Sandgem lab scene, one town closer. The bag inventory in line 5 is not flavour: PlayerProfile.InitialiseNewGame grants exactly 10 poke-ball, 5 potion and 2 antidote at the moment of choosing, so this line names what the player already has rather than inventing a second handout that would not match the save.

Lines.Text: You came back up the hill. Half the people I hand a Pokémon to never do.
Lines.TextKo: 올라왔군. 포켓몬 받고 다시 오는 사람은 절반도 안 되네.

Lines.Text: Registered. Signed for, in ink. It is yours now, properly, and nobody gets to take it back.
Lines.TextKo: 등록했네. 잉크로 적었고. 이제 정식으로 자네 걸세. 아무도 못 가져가네.

Lines.Text: And this. Hold it steady — it takes a moment to wake up.
Lines.TextKo: 그리고 이걸세. 잘 들고 있게. 깨는 데 좀 걸리네.

Lines.Text: It records what you meet. Not what you catch — what you meet. Look at something long enough for it to look back and the entry writes itself.
Lines.TextKo: 만난 걸 기록하네. 잡은 게 아니라 만난 걸세. 눈이 마주칠 만큼 오래 보면 알아서 적히네.

Lines.Text: There are more kinds living between this gate and the lake than I have entries for. I have been meaning to fix that for eleven years.
Lines.TextKo: 여기서 호수까지, 내 도감에 없는 놈들이 더 많네. 11년째 그러고 있지.

Lines.Text: Your bag: ten balls, five potions, two antidotes. Standard kit. It comes off the lab's budget and I would like the empty tins back.
Lines.TextKo: 가방에 몬스터볼 10개, 상처약 5개, 해독제 2개. 기본일세. 연구소 예산이니 빈 통은 가져오게.

Lines.Text: Take these as well. Repels. They keep the small ones off you while you work out which end of a battle you are on.
Lines.TextKo: 이것도 가져가게. 벌레회피스프레이일세. 배틀에 익숙해질 때까지 잔챙이는 안 붙네.

Lines.Text: That is everything. Bram has been told.
Lines.TextKo: 됐네. 브람한테는 말해 뒀고.

Sequences.Note: The last thing said before the ramp opens. It restates the anomaly from the morning bulletin, which is the only piece of plot the player is carrying.

Lines.Text: Go and look at the lake for me, {PLAYER}. Eleven centimetres.
Lines.TextKo: {PLAYER}. 가서 호수를 보고 오게. 11센티미터일세.

Lines.Text: And write down what you see before you decide what it means. That order. Always that order.
Lines.TextKo: 무슨 뜻인지는 나중에 정하게. 본 것부터 적고. 순서는 늘 그걸세.

Sequences.Note: Bram, state 1 of 3. NpcController._defaultDialogue. Active until story.starter_chosen.

Lines.Text: Not without a Pokémon. It isn't personal and it isn't negotiable.
Lines.TextKo: 포켓몬 없이는 안 돼요. 누구라서 그런 것도 아니고, 봐줄 수도 없어요.

Lines.Text: The professor is up at the lab. Go and be charming at him.
Lines.TextKo: 박사님은 연구소에 계세요. 가서 잘 말해 봐요.

Sequences.Note: Bram, state 2 of 3. Active on story.starter_chosen, until story.pokedex. This is the state that actually gates leaving town, and it exists so the reason is a person with an opinion rather than an invisible wall.

Lines.Text: You've got one. Good. That's my rule satisfied.
Lines.TextKo: 있군요. 좋아요. 내 규칙은 통과예요.

Lines.Text: The professor's rule isn't. He wants you at the lab first — something about ink. It's a two-minute walk.
Lines.TextKo: 박사님 규칙이 남았죠. 연구소부터 들르라시더군요. 잉크가 어쩌고. 걸어서 2분이에요.

Sequences.Note: Bram, state 3 of 3. Active on story.pokedex.

Lines.Text: Ramp's yours. Mind the second step.
Lines.TextKo: 가도 좋아요. 두 번째 계단 조심하고요.

Lines.Text: And come back through here now and then. It's a quiet job.
Lines.TextKo: 가끔 이쪽으로 들러요. 심심한 자리라서요.

Sequences.Note: Stallholder, default. DP's mother telling you Barry came round and it was an emergency -- the pointer that stops a player who has control and no idea what to do with it.

Lines.Text: Your friend came through at a run, took an apple, said he'd pay me Tuesday, and went straight up the lab lane.
Lines.TextKo: 친구가 아까 뛰어갔어요. 사과 하나 집어 가더니 화요일에 준대요. 그러고 연구소 골목으로 올라갔죠.

Lines.Text: He's still up there. He has not stopped talking since he arrived.
Lines.TextKo: 아직 거기 있을 거예요. 도착해서 입을 안 쉬더라고요.

Sequences.Note: Stallholder, alternate on story.pokedex.

Lines.Text: Off, then. Bring me back something with feathers on it and I'll paint it on the sign.
Lines.TextKo: 잘 다녀와요. 깃털 달린 거 하나 데려오면 간판에 그려 줄게요.

Sequences.Note: Gardener, default. One line, and its only job is to make the bulletin's eleven centimetres sound strange to somebody who would know.

Lines.Text: Eleven centimetres. I've put a stick in that lake every spring for thirty years and it has never once done that.
Lines.TextKo: 11센티미터라니. 30년째 봄마다 저 호수에 막대 꽂아 봤는데, 저런 적은 없었어요.
